options: so — otsiz (so tired); such — ot bilan (such a good film)
questions.explanation: Ot bor → such; otsiz → so.
such + (a) + sifat + OT.

options: too — ortiqcha (salbiy, muammo); very — neytral kuchaytirgich
questions.explanation: It's too hot to drink ≠ It's very hot.
Ot bilan esa OLDIN: enough money.

questions.text: «He was so tired ___ he slept» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: so/such ... that — natija bildiruvchi qurilma.
Ijobiy gap → inkor tag; inkor gap → ijobiy tag.
Maxsus holat: I am → aren't I.
Let's → shall we; buyruq → will you; there is → isn't there.
never/nobody/hardly inkor hisoblanadi → IJOBIY tag.

questions.text: Tag ohangi tushuvchi bo'lsa (↘) nima anglatiladi?
questions.explanation: Ko'tariluvchi ohang (↗) esa haqiqiy savolni bildiradi.

questions.text: «Could you tell me where ___ ?» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Embedded savolda oddiy so'z tartibi: ega + fe'l.

questions.text: «Do you know ___ it's open?» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: Yes/No savol embedded bo'lganda if/whether ishlatiladi.

questions.text: «I wonder where he lives» oxirida savol belgisi kerakmi?
questions.explanation: Could you tell me...? — savol (?); I wonder... — darak gap (nuqta).

questions.text: «Do you know who called?» — nega so'z tartibi o'zgarmagan?
questions.explanation: who/what ega bo'lsa, tartib o'zgarmaydi.
«Could you tell me where does he live» — xato.

questions.text: «would» o'tmish odati sifatida qaysi holatda ishlatilmaydi?
questions.explanation: Holat uchun faqat used to: I used to have a car (I would have — xato).
Inkorda ham: didn't USE to — «d» tushadi.

questions.text: «I'm used to waking up early» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: be/get used to + -ing — o'rganib qolgan; used to + V1 — o'tmish odati.

questions.text: «I went there twice» — bu yerda used to ishlatish mumkinmi?
options: Yo'q — aniq son/muddat bo'lsa Past Simple
questions.explanation: used to takroriy, davomli odat uchun; bir martalik ish uchun Past Simple.
«z» emas, «s» tovushi bilan o'qiladi.

title: Test — Make, let, be allowed to

questions.explanation: make + odam + V1 (to SIZ) = majburlamoq.
let + odam + V1 (to siz) = ruxsat bermoq.
be allowed TO + V1 — «to» bilan.
I was made to wait — passivda «to» qaytadi.
«I was let to go» — xato. To'g'risi: I was allowed to go.
not as ... as = kamroq (= comparative bilan teng ma'no).
Inkor tenglik qiyosiy darajaga aylanadi.

questions.text: Katta farqni ta'kidlash uchun qaysi so'z ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: «very + comparative» xato; «much better» to'g'ri.

questions.text: «the more, the better» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: the + comparative..., the + comparative... qolipi.
...er and ...er / more and more — o'sib boruvchi o'zgarish.

questions.text: «I like coffee» va «The coffee here is good» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Umumiy ma'no → artiklsiz; aniq ma'no → the.
the USA / the Nile / the Alps; lekin Japan / Paris / Everest — artiklsiz.
Qat'iy iboralar: go to bed/work/home, at night, by bus — artiklsiz.
at night (artiklsiz) ↔ in the morning (the bilan).

questions.explanation: O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q — shuning uchun ongli mashq kerak.

options: each — alohida-alohida; every — butun guruh sifatida
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi ham birlik fe'l oladi.
Olmosh oldidan «of» shart: all of us, both of them, none of us.
the whole + birlik = all (of) — butun.

questions.text: «None of them ___ here» — odatda qaysi shakl?
